nodes.label: Preposition + -ing
nodes.note: adjective/verb + preposition + -ing · plain prepositions + -ing · `to` preposition vs infinitive marker · 4 strands x 12 · built 2026-08-07 · PARKED 2026-08-24 (James): duplicate teaching. The RULE (after a preposition, -ing) is one exceptionless line, now taught on slide 4 of b1_verb_patterns_advanced. The COLLOCATIONS are b1_dependent_prepositions' ground — 13 of the 27 this unit claimed to add are already drilled there, 19 slots earlier and a level lower, and that unit gaps the PREPOSITION while this one gaps the verb form. Its own vocabulary is 84% A1, so it was never a B2 unit. A real B2 dependent-prepositions unit is wanted here — revision plus ~16 genuinely new B2/C1 collocations (accuse of, blame for, cope with, opposed to, satisfied with, consistent with, anxious about ...) — but NOTHING IS TO BE BUILT without careful planning first (his standing instruction). Left in path_order so indices do not shift.
